rows.title: Upload documents can be opened as soon as the origin is answered
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 lets the trader open Upload documents as soon as the origin of the import is answered. The real overview only unlocks the task once origin, commodities and commodity details are complete. After this the overview's 'Upload documents' link, and the page itself, can be reached once the origin is answered. The page keeps its current address: Sam's 9 October ruling dropped the move to a new address.
acceptanceCriteria: On a new live-animals notification with only the origin of the import answered, the overview's 'Upload documents' link can be followed and opens the page headed 'Upload documents', before the commodity or any later section is complete. (prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/documents.fit.spec.js:114-119; conflict c-083)

On a new live-animals notification with only the origin and the commodity answered, opening the Upload documents page shows the page headed 'Upload documents' rather than sending the trader elsewhere. (prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/documents.fit.spec.js:29-34 beforeEach)
notes: Rewritten on an earlier re-distil: Sam's 9 October ruling (claim 20) put req-477, the move of the page to a new address, out of scope, so this row keeps only the entry-guard slice (req-544). The page stays where it is today (req-1822, adopted as exists), and the tests repo's page object and the k6 documents script need no change.
The criteria assert the page by its heading, never by a literal path (req-1822).

Sam's 9 October afternoon ruling accepts the documents theme as distilled, inc-031 to inc-035 (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p2-051, p2-052). Plants has no documents page, so the same-increment plants rule changes nothing here (plants-common-mapping-2026-10-09.json, documents theme).

The documents section's obligation owns the guard; the journey's shared task rows and flow, which the journey-foundation rows also change, read it. If the combiner finds another row editing the documents task's gate, that shared change belongs in the foundation theme.

rows.title: Upload documents guidance, hints, table and maximum-documents error match Design Release 2.1
rows.detail: The real page's wording differs from Design Release 2.1 in the additional-documents table, the Document reference and Date of issue hints, the two Attachment hint bullets, the hidden heading of the added-documents table and the empty state, and it reports the 15-file limit against the documents table rather than the Attachment field. Each changes to the design's wording and placement so the trader sees what the design shows.
acceptanceCriteria: In the additional-documents table, the row 'Animals that do not need a health certificate' reads 'Exporter's declaration that they are fit to travel', with no leading 'An'. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/upload-documents.html:65-66; trace:prototype-dr2-1 documents--upload-documents-renders-the-upload-guidance-and-document-fields action 48 row 1)

The row 'Rodents imported for research purposes' reads 'RM39 licence and supplementary health certificate', with no leading 'An'. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/upload-documents.html:73-74; trace:prototype-dr2-1 documents--upload-documents-renders-the-upload-guidance-and-document-fields action 48 row 3)

The 'Document reference' field has no hint: 'For example, GBHC1234567890.' no longer shows. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/upload-documents.html:104-117; trace:prototype-dr2-1 documents--upload-documents-renders-the-upload-guidance-and-document-fields actions 40, 48)

The 'Date of issue' hint reads 'For example, 27/3/2026'. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/upload-documents.html:139-155; trace:prototype-dr2-1 documents--upload-documents-renders-the-upload-guidance-and-document-fields action 48)

The Attachment size bullet reads 'files that are smaller than 10MB'. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/upload-documents.html:171; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/documents.fit.spec.js:50-52; trace:prototype-dr2-1 documents--upload-documents-renders-the-upload-guidance-and-document-fields actions 43-48)

The Attachment file-type bullet reads 'PDF, DOC, DOCX, JPEG, JPG, PNG, XLS or XLSX', with no leading 'a'. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/upload-documents.html:172; trace:prototype-dr2-1 documents--upload-documents-renders-the-upload-guidance-and-document-fields actions 43-48)

The added-documents table's column headings are 'Document reference', 'Document type', 'Date of issue', 'Status' and a visually hidden 'Action'. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/upload-documents.html:195-213; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/documents.fit.spec.js:90-97; trace:prototype-dr2-1 documents--upload-documents-a-complete-document-is-listed-with-its-virus-check-status-and-can-be-removed actions 46, 51)

With no documents added, and again after the last document is removed, the File upload card shows no table and no 'You have not added any documents yet.' text. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/upload-documents.html:195; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/documents.fit.spec.js:107-109; trace:prototype-dr2-1 documents--upload-documents-a-complete-document-is-listed-with-its-virus-check-status-and-can-be-removed actions 60-62)

Trying to save a sixteenth document shows 'You can upload a maximum of 15 files' in the error summary, linked to the Attachment field, and the same message inline on the Attachment field. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:10949-10957; conflict c-075)
notes: Combines the copy slices req-488, req-489, req-494, req-505, req-508, req-510, req-528 and req-530 with the error-placement slice req-527: all are on the same page template and copy, reviewed against the same render, and the tests-repo specs that assert the empty-state text and the summary-only capacity error change together. The size bullet's number stays at the current limit here; the 50MB row (req-509, blocked) changes the number. Welsh copy keeps step with each English change where it has an equivalent.

Depends on the entry-guard row only so the documents rows land in one order on one branch; no criterion here needs it. Sam's 9 October afternoon ruling accepts the theme as distilled (p2-051, p2-052). Plants has no documents page (plants-common-mapping-2026-10-09.json).

rows.title: Document references accept punctuation, and the document type list drops Health certificate
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 accepts any non-blank document reference, such as 'ITAHC-001', and offers thirteen document types with no 'Health certificate'. Today a reference with a hyphen reaches the trader only as 'The file could not be uploaded. Try again.', and the select offers fourteen types. After this a reference with hyphens, slashes, spaces or other punctuation is accepted end to end, and the select offers the design's thirteen types in its order. Documents already saved as Health certificate still load and are still coded on the outbound event, because the backend keeps that type.
acceptanceCriteria: A document with the reference 'ITAHC-001' is added and listed in the added-documents table with that reference, with no upload error. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 TRACE C actions 92-95; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/support/journey.js:196-206; conflict c-065)

A document whose reference has slashes and spaces, such as 'GB/HC 2026 01', is added and listed with that reference, with no upload error. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 documents--upload-documents-a-date-of-issue-that-is-not-a-real-date action 39; conflict c-065)

The 'Document type' select offers, in this order after its placeholder: Intra Trade Animal Health Certificate (ITAHC), Veterinary health certificate, Air waybill, Import permit, Letter of authority (Directive 2008/61/EC), Commercial invoice, Sea waybill, Rail waybill, Bill of lading, Catch certificate, Laboratory sampling results for aflatoxin (Reg 2019/1793), Journey log, Other. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:10843-10861; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/documents.fit.spec.js:11-26; document:dr1-parity-backlog backlog.json inc-136; conflict c-085)
'Health certificate' is not among the Document type options. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:10843-10856; document:dr1-parity-backlog backlog.json inc-136; conflict c-085)

sources.ref: TRACE C actions 92-95; documents--upload-documents-a-date-of-issue-that-is-not-a-real-date action 39; poultry-by-rail action 90

notes: Combines the reference-characters slice (req-497, the backend's check on the document-upload request, proved through the page) and the document-type list slice (req-499, the frontend's options): both decide what a document may be, share the same add-a-document set-up, and are proved by the same tests-repo document specs. The backend keeps its Health certificate type so saved documents still load and are coded on the outbound event (conflict c-085); the review page keeps its label for that type. The page's own 58-character limit on the reference is unchanged. Re-raise req-497 if a downstream codelist proves to need a narrower character set.
The performance-tests suite's document references are letters and digits, so they stay valid once the backend accepts more; perftests needs no change and is not in repos.
Plants has no document entry or type list (plants-common-mapping-2026-10-09.json), so plantsfrontend is not in repos.

rows.title: Upload documents remembers where the trader came from and returns them there
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 returns the trader to where they started (the overview or the review page) however often the documents page reloads, so its Back link and Save and continue go back there; otherwise Save and continue goes to the next journey step, Consignment addresses. Amending a submitted notification always counts as coming from review. The real page has no return context: Back and Save and continue always go to the overview. Sam's 9 October ruling keeps the behaviour but says how it is carried is the service's own: the live flow's fallback to the overview and the existing change-from-review context, with no new marker in the address or the form.
acceptanceCriteria: Reached through the journey from the step before it, Save and continue on the page goes to the next step, the page headed for Consignment addresses (roles and addresses), including when no document is chosen. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:1517-1525, 12275-12278; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/documents.fit.spec.js:81-84; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/journeys.fit.spec.js:103-112; trace:prototype-dr2-1 documents--upload-documents-documents-are-optional-continuing-with-nothing-chosen-moves-on actions 31-33)

Opened from the overview, the page's Back link and Save and continue both return the trader to the overview. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:11089, 11093, 1588-1602; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 39; trace:prototype-dr2-1 documents--upload-documents-from-the-hub-save-and-return-to-overview-from-the-hub actions 25-27)
Opened from the review page, the page's Back link and Save and continue both return the trader to the review page. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:11089, 11093, 1588-1602; conflict c-060)

While amending a submitted notification, the page's Back link and Save and continue both go to the review page, however the page was opened. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:11069-11079, 11089, 11093)

After Save and add another, after Remove and after a validation error, the page still returns the trader where they started: Back and Save and continue go to the overview or review page the trader opened it from. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:11069-11079, 12239; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 39)
notes: Combines the return-context slice (req-542), the Back link slice (req-481) and the Save and continue destination slice (req-539): all three read the same return context and share one set-up (open the page from the overview, from review, while amending).

Sam's 9 October ruling (claims 17, 21 and 39; conflict c-237): no ?from=hub or ?from=review query and no hidden 'from' form field is added. The overview case rests on the live flow's fallback, which the journey-foundation row (inc-002) changes; the review and amending cases rest on the existing ?change=1 and amend state. Query and field names stay the service's own.
req-539's return to a template review is not a criterion: req-543 keeps the page out of template creation, so a trader never reaches it from a template review.

Depends on the journey-foundation rows for the step order (inc-001: Upload documents after the transporter and before Consignment addresses) and for the overview fallback (inc-002). The shared kit's change-context and next-target helpers are also used by other pages, so any change to them belongs to journey-foundation. The afternoon ruling's plants changes to inc-002 ride in that row; plants has no documents page, so nothing here changes plants.

rows.title: Save and continue no longer waits for virus scans, and Save and return to overview keeps a typed-in document
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 saves a complete document and moves the trader on at once when they press Save and continue, even while a document is still being scanned, and applies the same check before Save and return to overview, saving a document whose type is chosen. Today Save and continue saves the document and brings the trader back to the page, any document not yet scanned clean holds them, and Save and return to overview leaves at once and drops a part-filled document. Waiting for the scan is not a constraint, because the backend only publishes documents that scanned clean, so pending scans stop holding the trader; a document the scan rejected still does.
acceptanceCriteria: Save and continue with a document type chosen and every field valid saves the document and moves the trader on straight away, without returning to the page first; going back to the page lists the document. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:11046-11067, 12262-12273; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/journeys.fit.spec.js:103-112)

With a document still showing 'Scanning for virus', Save and continue moves the trader on, and 'You cannot continue until all documents have been scanned or removed' no longer appears. (prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/journeys.fit.spec.js:103-112; conflict c-080)

With a document listed as 'Virus found', Save and continue keeps the trader on the page with '<filename> contains a virus. Remove it and try again with a different file.' in the error summary. (conflict c-080; repo:backend accompanyingdocument/AccompanyingDocumentRepository.java:14-15)

Save and return to overview with a document type chosen and every field valid saves the document and goes to the overview; returning to the page lists it. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:12242-12257, 1564-1586; conflict c-082)

Save and return to overview with a document type chosen but another field missing or invalid keeps the trader on the page with that field's error, and the chosen type stays selected. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:12242-12257, 1564-1586; conflict c-082)

Save and return to overview with no document type chosen goes straight to the overview and adds no document. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:12242-12257; trace:prototype-dr2-1 documents--upload-documents-from-the-hub-save-and-return-to-overview-from-the-hub actions 25-27)
While amending a submitted notification, Save and return with a valid document whose type is chosen saves it and goes to the review page. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:12242-12257, 1564-1586)
notes: Combines the Save and continue slice (req-538) and the Save and return to overview slice (req-540): both decide what the page's save buttons do with a typed-in document and with documents still scanning, share one controller path and one set-up. Kept apart from the return-context row because that row's criteria rest on the journey's step order, which another area owns. A document needs every field, its file included, to be stored, so req-540's full check before leaving stands with the cross-page ruling in conflict c-211. The tests-repo scan-lifecycle spec that expects the scan to hold Save and continue changes here.

The 'Virus found' criterion is observable on the local stack: the stack's cdp-uploader container's mock scan rejects the tests repo's restricted file, as the existing reject spec already relies on; in CDP the real scan rejects it.

rows.title: Attach files up to 50MB
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 allows files up to 50MB, and DR1's inc-138 judged the same change. The backend already accepts 50MB. The frontend holds the limit at 10MB only because CDP's nginx ingress caps request bodies at 10 MiB; one limit applies in every environment, so the change waits until CDP raises that cap. Sam's 9 October afternoon ruling keeps this row blocked on that cap, tracked by EUDPA-518.
acceptanceCriteria: The Attachment size bullet reads 'files that are smaller than 50MB'. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/upload-documents.html:171; trace:prototype-dr2-1 TRACE C action 92; document:dr1-parity-backlog backlog.json inc-138)

A file of exactly 50,000,000 bytes is added and scans to 'Check completed' with no error, on the local stack and in every CDP environment. (document:dr1-parity-backlog backlog.json inc-138 finding.correction; trace:prototype-dr2-1 pet-cats-by-air action 89)

With JavaScript, choosing a file one byte over 50MB and submitting shows 'The selected file must be smaller than 50MB' in the error summary and inline on the Attachment field, and no document is added. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/upload-documents.html:171; document:dr1-parity-backlog backlog.json inc-138 finding.frontend)

Without JavaScript, submitting a file well over 50MB redraws the page with 'The selected file must be smaller than 50MB' in the error summary and inline on the Attachment field, rather than an error page, and no document is added. (document:dr1-parity-backlog backlog.json inc-138 finding.frontend; document:dr1-parity-notes Pins, lines 211-217)
openQuestions: Waits on CDP: CDP must raise the nginx ingress request-body cap in front of trade-imports-animals-frontend to at least 50,001,024 bytes, and the service team must record the confirmation against EUDPA-518, before this is built and deployed. Until then the limit stays at 10MB everywhere. Sam's 9 October afternoon ruling keeps it blocked on this (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p2-054).
notes: Kept apart from the copy row so the wording change (req-508) is not held up by the platform blocker. The route's payload cap is the limit plus 1KiB of multipart allowance. A configurable limit was rejected by DR1 because it gives no parity anywhere. The backend needs no change: it already accepts 50MB.

One limit applies in every environment and every set: if the germinal-products documents page (req-1825) has been copied before this unblocks, this row raises its limit too, and its criteria then hold on both sets' documents pages. Plants has no file attachment (plants-common-mapping-2026-10-09.json).

rows.title: Template creation leaves out Upload documents
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 keeps documents out of templates, because a document belongs to one consignment, and Sam's 9 October ruling confirms a template never offers documents. While a trader is creating a template, Upload documents is not a step of the journey and the template's overview offers no Documents task. The same ruling says the prototype's guards on the page's own address are not required, so none is built. No real service has templates yet, so this lands once the templates area has built template creation.
acceptanceCriteria: While creating a template, Save and continue on the transporter step goes to the page for Consignment addresses (roles and addresses), passing over Upload documents. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:1517-1525; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 21)

While creating a template, the template's overview shows no 'Upload documents' task and no Documents section to follow. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:1519-1521; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 21)
notes: Kept apart: it can only be observed once template creation exists, which the templates area builds. It depends on the templates area's row that lets a trader create a template and walk its journey (inc-155 today) and on the journey-foundation step-order row (inc-001); both are real ordering needs, not a layer split. Where template mode lives in the shared flow is for the templates area's rows to set, so the row keeps its theme, type-question-and-templates.

Sam's 9 October ruling (claim 21; conflict c-238): no redirect guard on the page's address in template mode. The templates ruling makes template mode on journey pages animals only (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates p1-044), so plants is not touched.

rows.title: Germinal products notifications have their own Upload documents page
rows.detail: Sam's 9 October ruling makes germinal products its own set in the animals frontend, each page a copy of its live-animals feature folder taken after this programme has built the live twin. Upload documents is one of the germinal set's pages: only Additional details, the CPH number and the permanent address are left out. The germinal set gets its own documents page, copied from the live-animals documents feature once the documents rows that can build now have landed, at the same slug within the germinal journey and behaving as every adopted documents requirement says. The Live Animals Germinals Data Fields page (V4) lists no germinal-specific document fields, so the page is the live-animals page unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: On a germinal products notification, the overview's 'Upload documents' task opens a page headed 'Upload documents' with the caption 'Documents', the same guidance, the 'Check which additional documents you must upload' details, the four fields (Document reference, Document type, Date of issue, Attachment) and the same hints and buttons as the live-animals documents page. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 1, 2, 3)

On a germinal products notification, a document with the reference 'ITAHC-001', a type, a date of issue and a PDF file is added: it is listed with 'Scanning for virus' and then 'Check completed', its 'View file' link downloads the file, and it is still listed after a reload. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 2; trace:prototype-dr2-1 TRACE C actions 92-95)

On a germinal products notification, Save and add another with nothing entered shows 'There is a problem' listing 'Enter a document reference', 'Select a document type', 'Enter a date of issue' and 'Upload a document', each inline on its field. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 2; trace:animals-fit p22-068)
On a germinal products notification, Remove takes a listed document off the page at once, and it is not listed after a reload. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 2; trace:animals-fit p22-058)

In the germinal products opening run, Save and continue on Upload documents goes to the germinal set's Consignment addresses (roles and addresses) page; opened from the germinal overview, Back and Save and continue return to that overview. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 1, 2, 39)

A document added on a germinal products notification is never listed on a live-animals notification's documents page, and the live-animals set's documents page does not open a germinal products notification. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 1, 4, 6)
The germinal products documents page has no serious or critical axe violations (WCAG 2.2 AA) when empty, in its error state and with a saved scanned document. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 15)
notes: Must come after every live-animals documents row that can build now (inc-031 to inc-035), so the copy carries their changes, and after the germinal set's own rows: the set and its mount, its overview, its step order and return rules, and category scoping (inc-176 today; the combiner adds the others by their ids). The blocked 50MB row (inc-036) is not waited on; when it unblocks it changes both sets' pages. Keeps its theme, germinal-products.

The backend's accompanying-document endpoints are keyed by notification reference and need no change for a germinal notification, so backend is not in repos. Its end-to-end, accessibility and security specs sit under the tests repo's animals project in the germinal-products folders; the security spec drives the germinal documents routes through the ZAP scan. Criteria assert the page by heading and destination, never by a literal path. Plants mapping: a straight copy within animals, no plants change (plants-common-mapping-2026-10-09.json inc-179).
